thread.title: UVXY, DIVB: Big ETF Outflows

author: BNK Invest
title: UVXY, DIVB: Big ETF Outflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Looking at units outstanding versus one week prior within the universe of ETFs covered at ETF Channel, the biggest outflow was seen in the ProShares ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF ( UVXY ), where 21,250,000 units were destroyed, or a 28.0% decrease week over week.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest outflow was the iShares U.S. Dividend and Buyback ETF ( DIVB ), which lost 50,000 of its units, representing a 16.7% decline in outstanding units compared to the week prior. Among the largest underlying components of DIVB, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is up about 1.3%, and Microsoft Corporation ( MSFT ) is higher by about 0.6%.
